answer: The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in vine, expire in horizon, and summit lists each expiry. An adversary running 90 aliases therefore needs 19 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1954 identities would post 1403 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
